Netgear Orbi RBK352 WiFi 6 AX1800 Dual Band Mesh System

Upgrade your home network with the Netgear Orbi RBK352 WiFi 6 Mesh System. Designed to provide seamless, high-speed coverage for homes up to 3,500 sq. ft., the Orbi RBK352 delivers ultra-fast internet speeds with WiFi 6 technology. Enjoy improved device capacity, greater efficiency, and less network congestion, making it perfect for households with multiple smart devices.


Key Features:

  • WiFi 6 Technology: Experience faster speeds, increased capacity, and improved efficiency for modern devices.
  • AX1800 Dual Band: Delivers up to 600 Mbps on 2.4GHz and 1200 Mbps on 5GHz for seamless HD streaming and gaming.
  • Mesh Network Coverage: Eliminate dead zones and enjoy reliable coverage throughout your home.
  • Gigabit Ethernet Ports: Equipped with 4 LAN ports on the router and 2 LAN ports on each satellite for high-speed wired connections.
  • Support for Multiple Devices: Connect up to 25 devices simultaneously, making it ideal for busy homes and small businesses.
  • Advanced Security: Protect your network with 128-bit AES encryption and secure WiFi protocols.
  • Easy Setup & Management: Set up and manage your WiFi network using the Orbi app or web interface.


Perfect for streaming, gaming, working from home, and managing multiple smart devices, the Netgear Orbi RBK352 offers an ideal solution for fast, reliable, and secure WiFi. Whether you’re in a medium or large-sized home, this mesh system ensures you have the connectivity you need to stay connected.
